events.title: Public Lecture: An Introduction to Classical Indian Philosophy
events.location: Brisbane Theosophical Society, 355 Wickham Terrace, Spring Hill
events.description: A deep-dive exploration of core tenets of Classical Indian philosophy in an intimate setting, designed for those interested in historical and metaphysical inquiry.

events.title: Sculptures & Sips: Kinetic Whale
events.description: A hands-on workshop led by professional puppeteers where participants build their own kinetic whale sculpture while enjoying a social, relaxed atmosphere.

events.title: Sculptors Queensland: Brisbane Sculpture Festival
events.description: An outdoor exhibition featuring a diverse range of large-scale sculptures displayed throughout the Botanic Gardens, encouraging contemplative walking and engagement with public art.
